test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The politician, along with the newsmen, __are expected shortly__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the original sentence is subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"the politician," **which is singular, so the verb should also be singular.
 
• **"Are" **is a plural verb, whereas** "is"** is a singular verb.
 
• Hence, the correct verb form is **'is expected shortly.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

Correct sentence: __The politician, along with the newsmen** is expected shortly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) were expected shortly: **This option uses the past tense verb "were," which is incorrect for the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2) am expected shortly: **This option uses the first-person singular form of the verb "am," which is not suitable for the subject "the politician."
 
• **Option 3) has expected shortly: **This option uses the present perfect tense verb "has," which is not suitable for the present tense context of the sentence.
